name: Reimbursement of membership Fee in Government promoted E-Commerce Portals
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** 80% of the membership/subscription fee is reimbursed, up to ₹25,000/- per financial year (excluding applicable taxes), whichever is less.- **Coverage:** Applicable for both new memberships and renewals on eligible e-commerce portals.
_eligibility_text: - Applicant should belong to Scheduled Caste(SC) / Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - He/She should represent any Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs).
